description: Sankey Diagram for Power BI, developed by SankeyArt, is built for enterprise finance and analytics teams who need to communicate financial data and relationships clearly. It helps teams avoid miscommunication and increase alignment across their organizations. Use cases: Visualize P&L statements, cash flows, and sales as Sankey diagrams Show revenue categories and contributions through Sankey flows Use Sankey branches for cost breakdowns and expense allocation Show month-over-month or year-over-year comparisons in Sankey labels Customization: Layout: Define the flow order and multi-level Sankey diagram structure Branding: Apply your corporate branding colors and fonts to the diagram Individual nodes: Use custom labels and colors for each node in your Sankey chart Trusted by leading companies SankeyArt’s diagramming software is available on the web, in Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI. It’s used by finance teams at leading companies like Amazon and L’Oréal across 40+ countries. “As CFO I look for ways to showcase data, and we wanted to use Sankey graphics for our financials. There were a number of companies and software providers offering 'easy' solutions. We explored many of them, and found SankeyArt to have a very clean and user-friendly interface, quick and extremely cost effective.” — Aaron Beveredige, CFO at Warren and Mohey Security and certification The Sankey Diagram for…
